name: LILYGO T-Display S3

memory.flash: 16MB measured by ROM flash-id on the identified sample
memory.psram: vendor8MB OPI; prior ROM observation embedded8MB, not application-memory qualification

touch.notes: Touch, when present, may be used for navigation experiments but not final approve/reject signing consent.

backlight.notes: LILYGO TFT_eSPI setup defines TFT_BL on GPIO38.

display_power.notes: Official FAQ says GPIO15 must be driven high for display power when running from battery.

display.notes: Selected no-camera non-touch S3 candidate for phase-one USB/display/two-button operation. Panel/bus/readability and physical input still require actual-sample D01/V01 evidence.

approval_inputs.name: approve
approval_inputs.notes: Long press on the vendor-documented KEY button. Touch-only approval remains disallowed.

approval_inputs.name: reject
approval_inputs.notes: Long press on the vendor-documented BOOT button. This is a development mapping and must be revalidated for production enclosure work.

navigation_inputs.name: back
navigation_inputs.notes: Short press on the vendor-documented BOOT button.

navigation_inputs.name: next
navigation_inputs.notes: Short press on the vendor-documented KEY button.

wireless_policy: Wireless must not participate in signing approval or request transport for this USB/Bridge profile. Software-disabled does not mean physically absent; enumerate actual radios/channels in D01.
debug_policy: Debug is a bring-up interface whose actual exposure and declared release policy must pass D02/D03. No real identity before independent profile admission; ordinary erase/reflash authorization does not authorize irreversible debug/eFuse settings.
production_signing: disabled until exact session profile display/input, entropy, no-persistence/lifecycle, firmware/update/recovery, host and release gates pass
reference_notes: Phase-one selected class is LILYGO T-Display-S3 non-touch with case and two buttons, not a universal Waveshare wallet or a scheduled legacy retirement.
GPIO14 KEY and GPIO0 BOOT mappings are vendor-source candidates; actual controls, panel/PCB, memory and enclosure behavior need D01 measurement.

ROM ESP32-S3v0.2, flash16MB and embedded8MB PSRAM descriptor were observed; PCB/panel and runtime remain unqualified. Secure Boot/Flash Encryption disabled does not prove empty eFuses. Do not infer Xtensa/ABI/backend/entropy or IDF6 support from P4.
firmware_status: Historical esp32_s3_usb_signer application was retired; this manifest does not identify a current qualified flashable product. D01/V01 must bind the actual new build.

custody.recovery: Local generation/import and local nsec backup/reload; no plaintext Bridge flow. Two-button usability and same-identity restore remain D02 gates.
custody.termination: Lock/disconnect/reset/power loss clear owned session secrets and invalidate consent under a measured lifecycle; no physical RAM-erasure claim.
custody.persistent_extension: Deferred; original D02 persistent encrypted-vault/PIN acceptance retained in plan/work-items.json.
